newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - Light ends slip, fuel edges up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - Light ends slip, fuel edges up.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday in quiet trading due to holidays across Europe.
Gasoline barges fell $1 but persistent talk of a squeeze in barges and U.S. demand for cargoes underpinned the market.
Naphtha was steady to slightly lower but heavier grades were buoyed by stronger gasoline prices and seasonal factors.
High sulphur barges picked up $1 to $81/$82 as Dutch traders returned to work. But only one trade was seen done and cargo markets were becalmed by Euro holiday torpor.
Heating oil was very narrowly easier by 50 cents or so on futures, but diesel was firm, with premiums a touch stronger on tight supplies.
